name: today
title: The front desk today
subtitle: Arrivals, departures, rooms and anything that needs a decision

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: Unassigned arrivals, double bookings, balances owing, overdue deposits, missing invoices, rooms not ready.
sections.sql: select reason, ref, guest, detail from v_attention order by reason, ref

sections.title: Arrivals today and tomorrow
sections.sql: select case when v.arrive_on = hotel_today() then 'today' else 'tomorrow' end as day, v.ref, v.guest, v.room_type as "room type", coalesce(v.room, 'not assigned') as room, v.nights, b.eta, v.channel, round(v.balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as balance from v_bookings v join bookings b on b.id = v.id where v.status = 'confirmed' and v.arrive_on between hotel_today() and hotel_today() + 1 order by v.arrive_on, v.room nulls first

sections.title: Departures today
sections.sql: select ref, guest, room, round(balance_cents / 100.0, 2) as balance from v_bookings where status = 'checked_in' and depart_on <= hotel_today() order by room

sections.title: Housekeeping
sections.note: Rooms with a guest arriving come first.
sections.sql: select room, status, housekeeping, in_house as "in house", arriving, eta from v_room_status order by case when housekeeping like 'clean now%' then 0 when housekeeping like 'check-out%' then 1 when housekeeping = 'stayover service' then 2 else 3 end, sort

name: performance
title: Occupancy, rate and channels
subtitle: The last twelve months and what is on the books

sections.title: Occupancy by month
sections.note: Occupancy is nights sold over room nights available. ADR is revenue per night sold. RevPAR is revenue per room night available.
sections.sql: select month, case when on_books then 'on the books' else 'actual' end as basis, room_nights as "room nights", nights_sold as "nights sold", occupancy_pct as "occupancy %", round(revenue_cents / 100.0, 2) as revenue, round(adr_cents / 100.0, 2) as adr, round(revpar_cents / 100.0, 2) as revpar from v_occupancy where nights_sold > 0 or on_books order by month

sections.title: Channels after commission
sections.note: Twelve months of arrivals. Commission uses each channel's rate on the record.
sections.sql: select channel, kind, bookings, nights, round(revenue_cents / 100.0, 2) as revenue, round(commission_cents / 100.0, 2) as commission, round(net_cents / 100.0, 2) as net, avg_lead_days as "avg lead days", cancelled from v_channel_mix order by net_cents desc

sections.title: The next twelve weeks
sections.sql: select w::date as "week of", count(n.id) as "nights on books", round(100.0 * count(n.id) / nullif((select count(*) from rooms where active) * 7, 0), 1) as "occupancy %", round(coalesce(sum(n.rate_cents), 0) / 100.0, 2) as revenue from generate_series(date_trunc('week', hotel_today()), date_trunc('week', hotel_today()) + interval '11 weeks', interval '1 week') w left join (select n.* from booking_nights n join v_live b on b.id = n.booking_id) n on n.night_on >= w::date and n.night_on < w::date + 7 group by w order by w
